page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes in the right margin, running down beside the lines of the column. Running head at top: "ANNUS MDXXV." with page number 239 at the top right.

main_text.p: Cursum Evangelii remorata sunt in Germania & extra Germaniam, bellum rusticanum & Sacramentarium: in Helvetia & Moravia secta Anabaptistica: in Silesia, secta Schwenckfeldica: in Boëmia, Apostasia Caroli Ducis Monsterbergensis: quibus adde, si placet, nuptias Lutheri, alienissimo tempore celebratas.a Zwinglius praefatione comcentaro de vera & falsa religione ad Francisc am Gal liarum Reginam, prae fixa.
main_text.head: BELLUM RUSTICANUM multum nocuit Evangelio.
main_text.p: Nam qui in Suevia coïerant rustici, Articulorum Magistratibus propositorum primo liberam Evangelii praedicationem sibi concedi armatis precibus postulabant. Et qui motus in Thuringia plebeios rusticosq; suscitavit Thomas Müncerus, praeco fuerat Evangelicus, sed ab Evangelio Christi ad somnia Diaboli, & a somniis ad seditiones publicas dilapsus. Hinc passim in Germania Pontificiorum in Evangelicos auditae voculae: Hinc nova doctrina, hinc Evangelij Lutheranici fructus? b Sequentia scripta Lutheri reperiuntur Tomo tertio operum eius Germ.a In Gallia etiam clarissimam Reginam, Francisci Regis captivi matrem, quidam in hanc sententiam pertrahere conatus est, ut obstaret doctrinae Evangelii, tanquam pacis turbatrici. In Germania enim omnia esse mixta, neminem audire Principum imperia, & turbata prorsus esse omnia.
bLUTHERus ut scandalo huic occurreret, glisccente adhuc diffidio, antequam plebei arma sumpsissent, edito scripto, omnes a seditione, Jen. Summa verò corundem Latinè legatur apud Sleid. lib. v.velut

page.notes: Marginal notes in the right margin are small and partly cut; the notes were transcribed as best read. Reference marks a and b appear in the text. Some words in the margin notes are doubtful, notably "Tomo tertio" and "Sleid. lib. v". The text at the foot ("velut") is the catchword. Digitiser watermark "Digitized by Google" omitted.
